## 6. Querying the Registry

```bash
# All active engineer skills in stable
jq '.skills[] | select(.kit=="engineer" and .channels.stable and (.channels.stable.deprecated|not)) | .name' \
  /Users/thieunv/projects/personal/vividkit-web/reference/skills-registry.json

# Skills present in beta but not stable
jq '.skills[] | select(.channels.beta and (.channels.stable|not)) | .name' \
  /Users/thieunv/projects/personal/vividkit-web/reference/skills-registry.json

# Marketing commands tree
jq '.commands[] | .name' \
  /Users/thieunv/projects/personal/vividkit-web/reference/skills-registry.json
```
